title: 第11章 悄然破境气入二层第12章 日常蛰伏静待机缘
slug: 凡人修仙开局觉醒寂灭道体
lines: 暮色散尽，沉沉夜色彻底笼罩青岚宗后山。
杂役院内灯火稀疏零落，大半木屋都归于寂静。
终日劳作的杂役弟子早已歇息安睡，无人再随意走动闲谈。
山间夜风穿林而过，吹动枝叶沙沙轻响。
偶尔几声虫鸣低吟，衬得整片后山越发幽静冷清。
林宸将木屋门窗紧闭，隔绝外界所有风声与动静。
屋内光线昏暗，四下安宁，自成一处不受打扰的静修之地。
他盘膝端坐在木床之上，双目轻闭，呼吸悠长匀净。
经过一下午的打坐沉淀，他早已把炼气一层的根基打磨到极致圆满。
丹田之内灵力浑厚凝练，周身经脉被灵气反复冲刷，变得宽阔通畅。
体内淤积的凡尘浊气，也被一点点净化消解了大半。
寂灭道体潜藏在血肉肌理之间，依旧被俗世浊气层层封掩。
没有任何神异迹象外露，只默默赋予他两项得天独厚的优势。
一是天生与天地灵气极为亲和，吸纳速度远超普通凡人修士。
二是肉身筋骨本就坚韧不凡，经得起灵气反复淬炼打磨。
这般底子，放在一众杂役弟子之中，已然是天差地别。
先前林宸一直刻意隐忍，迟迟没有选择冲破境界关卡。
只因杂役院局势微妙，管事王奎暗中对他存有留意。
赵虎等人更是心怀记恨，暗地里也在观望窥探。
若是贸然突破修为，气息陡然变强，必定引来旁人猜忌与忌惮。
木秀于林，风必摧之，身处宗门底层，低调蛰伏才是自保上策。
而如今风波早已平息。
赵虎经受过惨败教训，又被管事暗中敲打，早已安分蛰伏，再不敢滋生寻衅之心。
王奎也找不到合理由由头，再来刻意刁难问责。
院中其他弟子更是心存敬畏，只敢远远避让，无人敢贸然窥探打扰。
眼下时机已然成熟，再无需刻意压制自身修为。
林宸心神沉静如水，摒除一切杂念浮躁。
不再刻意压制体内涌动的灵力，缓缓运转宗门基础吐纳心法。
周身天地间稀薄的灵气，不受控制般向木屋聚拢而来。
丝丝缕缕纯净灵气顺着周身毛孔渗入体内，循着经脉温顺流转，尽数朝着丹田气海汇聚。
寻常修士冲击境界，往往心绪浮躁，把控不好灵力火候。
要么灵力过猛伤及经脉，要么底蕴不足卡在瓶颈，久久难以突破。
稍有不慎，还会导致根基虚浮，影响日后整条修行之路。
但林宸完全没有这方面的顾虑。
他拥有前世完整的修行阅历，精通每一个境界的破境诀窍。
每一分灵力的流转、每一次冲击的力道，都拿捏得恰到好处。
content_en:
The twilight dissipated, and the dark night completely enveloped the back mountain of Qinglan Sect.
The lights in the yard were sparse and scattered, and most of the wooden houses were silent.
The handyman disciples who had been working all day had already rested and slept, and no one was walking around and chatting freely anymore.
The night wind in the mountains passes through the forest, rustling the branches and leaves softly.
Occasionally, the chirping of insects makes the entire mountain behind become more quiet and deserted.
Lin Chen closed the doors and windows of the wooden house tightly to block out all the wind and movement from the outside world.
The room is dimly lit and peaceful, making it a place of undisturbed retreat.
He sat cross-legged on the wooden bed, his eyes lightly closed, and his breathing was long and even.
After an afternoon of meditation, he had already polished the foundation of Qi Refining to perfection.
The spiritual power in the Dantian is strong and concentrated, and the meridians throughout the body are repeatedly washed by the spiritual energy, becoming wide and smooth.
Most of the turbid odor accumulated in the body was purified and dissipated little by little.
The Taoist body of Nirvana is hidden among the flesh and blood texture, still covered by layers of turbid air in the world.
There was no sign of the magic being revealed, only two unique advantages were silently given to him.
First, he is born with an extremely close affinity to the spiritual energy of heaven and earth, and can absorb it much faster than ordinary mortal monks.
Second, the muscles and bones of the physical body are inherently tough and can withstand repeated tempering and polishing by spiritual energy.
Such a foundation, placed among a group of handyman disciples, is already a world of difference.
Lin Chen had been deliberately forbearing before and had not chosen to break through the realm.
Just because of the delicate situation in the courtyard, the steward Wang Kui secretly paid attention to him.
Zhao Hu and others even harbored a grudge and were secretly watching and snooping.
If one breaks through the cultivation level rashly and his aura suddenly becomes stronger, it will definitely arouse suspicion and fear from others.
Even if a tree is beautiful in the forest, the wind will destroy it. Being at the bottom of the sect, keeping a low profile and dormant is the best way to protect yourself.
But now the storm has long subsided.
Zhao Hu had experienced a tragic defeat and was secretly beaten by his supervisor. He had already settled down and hunkered down, and no longer dared to be provocative.
Wang Kui couldn't find a reasonable excuse and deliberately made things difficult for him to hold accountable.
The other disciples in the courtyard were even more in awe and dared to stay away from him. No one dared to pry and disturb him.
Now that the time is ripe, there is no need to deliberately suppress one's own cultivation.
Lin Chen's mind was as calm as water, eliminating all distracting thoughts and impetuous thoughts.
No longer deliberately suppressing the spiritual power surging in the body, slowly operating the sect's basic breathing method.
The thin spiritual energy between heaven and earth around him gathered towards the wooden house uncontrollably.
Strands of pure spiritual energy seep into the body along the pores all over the body, flow gently along the meridians, and converge towards the sea of ​​energy in the Dantian.
Ordinary monks who are trying to reach the realm are often in a restless mood and cannot control their spiritual power well.
Either the spiritual power is too strong and damages the meridians, or the foundation is insufficient and stuck at the bottleneck, making it difficult to break through for a long time.
A little carelessness can lead to a weak foundation and affect the entire path of spiritual practice in the future.
But Lin Chen had no worries about this at all.
He has complete training experience in his previous life and is proficient in the secrets of breaking through every realm.
Every flow of spiritual power and the force of every impact were perfectly controlled.
title_en: Chapter 11 Quietly breaking through the realm and entering the second level Chapter 12 Daily dormant and waiting for opportunities
